title: ～てあげる — “do ～ for someone”
summary: Shows that you (or your family) do something for someone else. Add あげる to the te-form. The person who receives it is marked with に.

patterns.gloss: Verb te-form + あげる (教えてあげる)

body.p: Use it when you do something helpful out of kindness: 友達に道を教えてあげた. It is the action version of あげる (to give).
With a superior it can sound as if you are doing them a favor. Use ～て差し上げる, or offer with ～ましょうか.

examples.ja: 友達（ともだち）に駅（えき）までの道（みち）を教（おし）えてあげました。
examples.romaji: Tomodachi ni eki made no michi o oshiete agemashita.
examples.tr: I showed my friend the way to the station.

examples.ja: 妹（いもうと）にケーキを作（つく）ってあげました。
examples.romaji: Imōto ni kēki o tsukutte agemashita.
examples.tr: I made a cake for my little sister.

examples.ja: 道（みち）が分（わ）からない人（ひと）に地図（ちず）をかいてあげた。
examples.romaji: Michi ga wakaranai hito ni chizu o kaite ageta.
examples.tr: I drew a map for a person who didn't know the way.

pitfalls: Do not use it to superiors.
The receiver takes に, the thing acted on takes を.
